fact: Statistics Mauritius released online on 28 June 2024 the seventeenth Economic and Social Indicators issue on Crime, Justice and Security Statistics for 2023, based on administrative data from the Mauritius Police Force, the Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions, the Judiciary, the Mauritius Prison Service and the Probation and After Care Service (Issue 1799, Year 2023 edition).
title: Economic and Social Indicators: Crime, Justice and Security Statistics, Year 2023 (Issue 1799)
